body:

text:
Hearth Hub unresponsive after router update

Hi there,

My Hearth Hub stopped syncing last night when my router updated to WPA3 security. My smart lights aren't responding to it anymore.

I've already tried restarting the hub, resetting it to factory settings, and reinstalling the app. It still won't connect back up.

Could someone please help me re-pair it with the new network standards?
reference_answer: This is a known issue: Hearth Hub firmware before 5.1 does not support WPA3-only Wi-Fi security, which new or updated routers often use. In your router settings, set Wi-Fi security to WPA2/WPA3 mixed (also called WPA3 transition mode). The hub will then reconnect and update itself to firmware 5.1, after which WPA3-only also works.
